sourcePrompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Edit target: the attached APPROVED photograph of Matteo in a black polo and glasses. This exact approved hero photograph is the sole identity source.
Primary request: derive a convincing, naturally photographic CLOSE-UP PORTRAIT of the very same man for the second section of his personal website. Preserve his face with the smallest possible change. Treat this as a closer portrait from the same photo shoot, not a redesign of the person.
Composition: vertical 7:8 image, head and shoulders and upper chest only. Whole hair visible with modest headroom. Face noticeably larger than in the original hero. Relaxed shoulders, gentle natural head angle similar to the source, warm real tooth-showing smile and direct eye contact. Keep his existing expression and recognizable facial asymmetry; don't invent a bigger or different smile. No hands, waist or legs.
Identity invariants: preserve the exact facial proportions, eyes, nose, mouth and actual teeth, cheek shape, jawline, short irregular curly brown hair and hairline, light stubble, small hoop earring, black rectangular clear-lens glasses with pale temples, and natural skin texture. Do not beautify, slim, symmetrize, exaggerate muscles, age him, smooth his skin or replace him with a stock-photo model. His face should look like the APPROVED HERO FACE at a closer distance.
Wardrobe: the same BLACK cotton polo, identical collar and realistic fabric texture. Full natural COLOR with the same skin tone and soft believable light as the hero, with gently clear facial detail and no exaggerated studio retouching.
Background: plain opaque near-black #05060a, matching the source, no gray studio wall, no gradient, no halo or colored rim. Keep the dark polo distinct through natural fabric highlights. One person only. No jacket or white shirt, no text, logos, astronaut, scenery or collage.
Priority order: exact identity and facial expression fidelity, credible photography, close portrait framing.
rendering: Square CSS cover aligned to the top preserves the approved full hairstyle and face; resized and encoded only.
